title: XPath workflow
description: A workflow document, schema 1: stages that run in order, each with jobs that run in parallel.

lock.description: One run at a time per project.

inputs.description: The variables a dispatch can set (inputs.<name>).

condition.description: An expression, such as platform == 'android' && flavor.prod.

kind.description: Runs flutter analyze and fails on issues.

failOn.description: The least severe issue that fails the step.

kind.description: Builds an APK or an App Bundle of the flavor.

artifact.description: An APK to install, or an App Bundle for Google Play.

dartDefineFile.description: A JSON or .env file of --dart-define values, in the app; the flavor's dart_defines credential by default.

obfuscate.description: Obfuscate the Dart code and keep its symbols.

keystore.description: Sign with the keystore of the flavor, when it has one.

kind.description: Builds and signs an IPA of the flavor.

exportOptionsPlist.description: The export options plist, in the app.

dartDefineFile.description: A JSON or .env file of --dart-define values, in the app; the flavor's dart_defines credential by default.

obfuscate.description: Obfuscate the Dart code and keep its symbols.

kind.description: Checks that the build has the values of the dart-define file in it.

artifactName.description: The artifact to look in; the one of the job by default.

dartDefineFile.description: A JSON or .env file of --dart-define values, in the app; the flavor's dart_defines credential by default.

keys.description: The keys of the file whose values must be in the build.

needles.description: Other text that must be in the build.

kind.description: Runs a program in the app, with the variables you give it.

executable.description: The program to run, such as dart or ./tool/x.sh.

workingDirectory.description: A folder inside the app to run it in.

passThroughEnvironment.description: Environment variables of the engine to pass on.

secretEnvironment.description: Variables set to stored secrets, by variable.

secretFiles.description: Variables set to the path of a stored secret file.

sideEffect.description: Whether it changes something outside the job.

kind.description: Makes the worktree of the job at the commit of the run, or at the commit an earlier job left.

commitFrom.description: A job of an earlier stage whose commit to start from.

kind.description: Pushes the release branch and the tag to GitHub.

branch.description: Push the release branch; when the run bumps by default.

kind.description: Makes the release branch of the version at the commit.
Tags the commit with the version and build number.
Opens a pull request from the release branch.

body.description: The description of the pull request.

kind.description: Merges the pull request of the release.
Stops the job when a check fails: the version, the store, the credentials, native changes in a patch.

checks.description: The checks to run before going on.

credentialKinds.description: The credentials the flavor must have, checked.

kind.description: Removes frameworks from the iOS archive and exports the IPA again.

frameworks.description: The frameworks to strip from the archive.

exportOptionsPlist.description: The export options plist, in the app.

dartDefineFile.description: A JSON or .env file of --dart-define values, in the app.

kind.description: Records what the release was built from.

dartDefineFile.description: A JSON or .env file of --dart-define values, in the app; the flavor's dart_defines credential by default.

kind.description: Builds a patch of a Shorebird release and publishes it.

platform.description: The platform; the one of the job by default.

exportOptionsPlist.description: For iOS, the export options plist, in the app.

dartDefineFile.description: A JSON or .env file of --dart-define values, in the app; the flavor's dart_defines credential by default.

obfuscate.description: Obfuscate the Dart code and keep its symbols.

allowNativeDiffs.description: Patch even when native code changed since the release.

shorebirdAppId.description: The Shorebird app; the one of the flavor by default.

kind.description: Builds a release that Shorebird can patch later.

platform.description: The platform; the one of the job by default.

artifact.description: For Android, an APK or an App Bundle.

exportOptionsPlist.description: For iOS, the export options plist, in the app.

dartDefineFile.description: A JSON or .env file of --dart-define values, in the app; the flavor's dart_defines credential by default.

obfuscate.description: Obfuscate the Dart code and keep its symbols.

keystore.description: Sign with the keystore of the flavor, when it has one.

shorebirdAppId.description: The Shorebird app; the one of the flavor by default.

kind.description: Promotes a patch of a release to the stable track, or rolls it back.

patchNumber.description: The patch of the release to move.

action.description: Promote the patch to the stable track, or roll it back.

shorebirdAppId.description: The Shorebird app; the one of the flavor by default.

kind.description: Pauses, resumes or completes Apple's phased release, or sets, halts or completes Google Play's staged rollout.

action.description: Apple: pause, resume or complete. Google Play: fraction, halt or complete.

userFraction.description: For "fraction", the share of users, above 0, at most 1.

kind.description: Keeps the debug symbols of the build, to read crash reports later.

android.description: Keep the Android symbols; in an Android job by default.

ios.description: Keep the iOS symbols; in an iOS job by default.

debugInfoDirectory.description: Where the build wrote the Dart symbols.

dartDefineFile.description: A JSON or .env file of --dart-define values, in the app.

kind.description: Runs flutter test and keeps the results.

paths.description: The test files or folders; all tests by default.

tags.description: Run only the tests with these tags.

kind.description: Uploads the IPA to App Store Connect, for TestFlight.

artifactName.description: The file to upload; the IPA of the job by default.

artifactsFrom.description: A build job of an earlier stage to take the file from.

bundleId.description: The bundle id; the one of the flavor by default.

appleAppId.description: The App Store Connect app id, a number.

kind.description: Sends the build to testers with Firebase App Distribution.

artifactName.description: The file to upload; the APK of the job by default.

artifactsFrom.description: A build job of an earlier stage to take the file from.

appId.description: The Firebase app id, such as 1:123:android:abc.

groupAliases.description: Tester groups to invite, by alias.

kind.description: Uploads the App Bundle to a track of Google Play.

artifactName.description: The file to upload; the App Bundle of the job by default.

artifactsFrom.description: A build job of an earlier stage to take the file from.

packageName.description: The application id; the one of the flavor by default.

track.description: The track: internal, alpha, beta, production or yours.

status.description: Release now, roll out to a fraction, or keep a draft.

userFraction.description: For a roll-out, the fraction of users, above 0, below 1.

releaseNotes.description: What is new, by language, such as en-US.

kind.description: Writes the version and build number of the run to the pubspec and commits it in the job.
